lines: Hell Wasps, gigantic wasp monsters about the size of a human being, were swarming together, approaching all at once and clicking their teeth ferociously.
Behind them, a Devil Worm was hungrily squirming its massive body, which was two metres in diameter, and twenty in overall length.
「There are quite a lot of them, aren't there?」
「It's no big deal. I'll do that big one. The bugs I'll leave to the President.」
Before Mitsuki could issue orders, Mutsuho had gone ahead and charged into the swarm of enemies.
Using the Yanagi family's unique, gliding martial arts techniques (which had grown even more fluid than in their student days), she masterfully avoided the swarm of Hell Wasps,
And approached the Devil Worm in the blink of an eye, then stabbed it with the poison needle on her tekkou. (TL: Forearm-protecting ninja gauntlet.)
The Devil Worm was vividly writhing.
Though this was Mitsuki's first time seeing it in actual combat, the strength of Mutsuho's poison was unquestioned.
Thinking that she would just have to leave that to her, Mitsuki opened her fan against the approaching Hell Wasps.
Although she wanted to snare them all at once with vacuum blades if possible, in this narrow sewer passage, she might also end up hurting Mutsuho, who was on the other side of them.
She swung her fan downwards, and a gust of wind was created by it.
That instantly reached the swarm of Hell Wasps, and turned into a tornado which centred around them.
Within that swirling air, the Hell Wasps had their wings torn off, and were flung and splatted against the sewer walls.
Since she had moderated her power so as not to harm Mutsuho, she hadn't defeated all of them.
Furthermore, she could hear the buzzing of new Hell Wasps, which had realized that their friends were being killed.
Mutsuho had also been having an unexpectedly difficult fight with the Devil Worm.
「What's with this thing?! My poison won't go around its body?! This is why I hate lower life forms!!」
「Yanagi-san, the time for the diversion is approaching. We have to hurry!」
「I know that! But like I said, this thing's got poor blood circulation! Die already!!」
She was irritated, stabbing her poison needle into it over and over and over again.
Every time she did, the Devil Worm writhed violently, but it was not enough for it to die from the poison.
（We can't afford to eat up our time here. What should I do......?!）
Mitsuki struggled to decide, and that moment, encouraging words came in from Rin.
「Yanagi!! Pull back! I'll do it!! Hoshino, prepare to Gale Soar! We'll break through all at once!」
Mitsuki reflexively nodded at those unwavering words,
「No need. I can handle a guy this―――Eh?」
And conversely, Mutsuho had been about to defy her, but
Without waiting for the pair's replies, Rin had invoked her Lightning Escape powers.
As the nickname “Electric Glow” implied, the electricity which coursed through Rin's body shone brightly.
Mitsuki could see Mutsuho distancing herself from the Devil Worm in a panic.
The lightning bolts that Rin shot off struck the Devil Worm's entire body.
It writhed more painfully than with Mutsuho's poison.
The Independent Commando Unit had also overcome a predicament by driving a Devil Worm's sensory organs haywire using Electric Escape Arts.
Even though she had read the report, using Rin's Ninja Arts hadn't occurred to her until just now.
However, the time for reflection was later.
Mitsuki also unleashed her wind powers.
This was a Ninja Art which performed high-speed travel by using a tornado to send herself and her allies flying.
Mitsuki boarded that tornado. And, while sending Rin and herself flying,
She reached her hand out all the way,
And blasted straight down the sewer tunnel in a single stretch, ignoring the Hell Wasps and Devil Worm.
